buyer_question: Referrals are ageing but nobody owns the next action
patient_engagement_route: May improve reminders and patient messaging after source and consent boundaries are clear
rcm_prior_auth_route: Can help prior-auth/eligibility workflows when payer status and documentation owners are known
ai_receptionist_call_center_route: Can capture callbacks or overflow but must not decide clinical, payer or coverage questions
ehr_pms_route: Can show workqueues if configured and owner-reviewed
grc_finops_adviser_route: May clarify privacy/security/cost questions but not patient-access ownership alone
aics_owner_evidence_route: AICS maps redacted referral source, age band, blocker, owner role and next safe handoff before platform selection
unsafe_claim_boundary: Do not claim appointment growth, denial reduction or faster authorization without measured approved evidence

buyer_question: Prior authorization status is delaying scheduling

rcm_prior_auth_route: Strong fit for payer portal/documentation workflow when billing/coding/payer owners approve
ai_receptionist_call_center_route: Must escalate coverage, clinical, symptom or payer-decision questions to humans
ehr_pms_route: May hold status fields but stale or ambiguous statuses remain unsafe
aics_owner_evidence_route: AICS separates missing-document, payer-status, adviser-needed and unsafe-answer rows in a no-PHI queue
unsafe_claim_boundary: Do not provide billing, coding, payer, legal, privacy, security, clinical or medical advice

buyer_question: Patients ask AI or front desk for unsafe answers
patient_engagement_route: Can send approved scripts but needs stop rules
rcm_prior_auth_route: Can route authorization status but not clinical judgement
ai_receptionist_call_center_route: Useful for triage/overflow only with explicit human handoff and forbidden-answer boundaries
ehr_pms_route: Can enforce templates if owners maintain them
grc_finops_adviser_route: GRC/trust routes document policy but not every live callback edge case
aics_owner_evidence_route: AICS publishes AI receptionist stop rules and human-review lanes before automation
unsafe_claim_boundary: Do not claim HIPAA/SOC2/HITRUST/BAA compliance proof or AI accuracy from this matrix
